from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-2/play/users/u021/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path=program_dir/'task-cfe406db.py'
program_text='''def transform(grid):
    grid = [row[:] for row in grid]
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    for color in set(v for row in grid for v in row) - {background, 1}:
        if any(all(value == color for value in row) for row in grid):
            for row in grid:
                first = next((i for i, value in enumerate(row) if value == color), None)
                if first is None:
                    continue
                end = first
                while end < width and row[end] == color:
                    end += 1
                if end < width and all(value == background for value in row[end:]):
                    row[end:] = [1] * (width - end)
    return grid
'''
program_path.write_text(program_text)
ns={}
exec(compile(program_text, str(program_path), 'exec'), ns)
